name: Paradoxum X Machina
source:
The world was nearly destroyed during a great war thousands of years ago, and now civilization finds itself on the verge of repeating history. A mere spark could ignite the powder keg of war.

During this modern era, military might has become obsolte, swapped in favor of Battle matrixes-mighty machines that only a few are worthy of piloting.

A young dog is thrown in the middle of this mess as one of its centerpieces while he struggles to find out more about himself and the world around him, unaware of the calamity that is about to fall upon.

Whatever happens on the road towards the end, it doesn't matter. What matters is that you always remember only one thing-the most important thing.

[From [url=https://sparkao.itch.io/paradoxum-machina]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
数千年前的一场大战几乎将世界彻底摧毁，而如今的人类文明正站在重蹈覆辙的悬崖边缘，哪怕一星半点的火花都足以引爆战争的火药桶。

在这个现代纪元，传统军力早已遭到淘汰，取而代之的是唯有极少数天选之人方有资格驾驭的强悍兵器——“战斗矩阵”。

一名年轻的犬兽人作为核心人物被卷入了这场乱局的漩涡中心，对即将降临的灭顶灾厄浑然不知的他，只能在挣扎中探寻自己的身世与周围世界的真相。

无论通往终局的旅途上会发生什么，都无关紧要。唯一重要的是，你必须时刻铭记一件事——那件最重要的事。

[摘自[url=https://sparkao.itch.io/paradoxum-machina]itch.io[/url]]
